lba_qa.q: Milk turning into curd and water evaporating — which one is a chemical change and why?
lba_qa.a:
Milk turning into curd is a chemical change.
Reasons:
1. A new substance (lactic acid) is formed
2. Original milk cannot be recovered
3. Taste, smell and composition change permanently

Water evaporating = Physical change (can be reversed by condensation).

lba_qa.q: When LPG burns in a kitchen stove, heat and light are released. What type of reaction is this? Give one more example from daily life.
lba_qa.a:
LPG burning is an Exothermic Reaction — energy is released.
C3H8 + 5O2 → 3CO2 + 4H2O + Heat

Daily life examples:
1. Burning of matchstick releases heat ✅
2. Rusting of iron slowly releases heat ✅
3. Respiration in our body releases energy ✅

lba_qa.q: A copper vessel gradually turns green over time. What is the reason? Identify the type of chemical reaction.
lba_qa.a:
Copper reacts with moisture, CO2 and O2 in air to form Copper Carbonate (green layer).
2Cu + O2 + CO2 + H2O → Cu(OH)2.CuCO3 (green)

This is:
- An Oxidation Reaction ✅
- Also called Corrosion ✅

Prevention: Apply paint or protective coating on copper surface.

lba_qa.q: Manufacturers flush nitrogen gas into chips packets. What would happen if ordinary air was used instead?
lba_qa.a:
If ordinary air is used:
- O2 in air would oxidise the oil in chips
- Rancidity would occur
- Chips would develop bad smell and taste
- Harmful for health

With Nitrogen gas:
- N2 is an inert gas — does not react
- Oxidation is prevented
- Chips remain fresh for longer ✅

This is an example of preventing Rancidity.

lba_qa.q: When an iron nail is placed in copper sulphate solution, the blue colour fades and a brown deposit appears on the nail. Explain why.
lba_qa.a:
Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu

Reason:
- Iron is more reactive than copper
- Iron displaces copper from copper sulphate solution
- CuSO4 (blue) → FeSO4 (light green)
- Copper (brown) deposits on the iron nail

This is a Displacement Reaction ✅

lba_qa.q: Iron rusts faster in a damp room than in a dry room. Give the chemical reason. Suggest two methods to prevent rusting.
lba_qa.a:
In a damp room:
- More moisture + O2 speeds up the corrosion reaction
4Fe + 3O2 + xH2O → 2Fe2O3.xH2O (rust/brown)

In dry room: less moisture → slow reaction

Prevention Methods:
1. Galvanization — coating iron with Zinc ✅
2. Painting or applying oil/grease ✅

lba_qa.q: Cooked food spoils faster at room temperature but stays fresh longer in a refrigerator. Explain the chemical reason.
lba_qa.a:
Cooked food spoiling = Oxidation + Microbial/bacterial reaction

In a Refrigerator:
- Low temperature slows down the rate of chemical reactions
- Bacterial growth is inhibited
- Effect of O2 is reduced

Refrigeration is a method to prevent Rancidity ✅
Low temperature = slower oxidation rate

lba_qa.q: Slaked lime Ca(OH)2 is used for whitewashing walls. The wall gradually hardens after whitewashing. Give the chemical reason.
lba_qa.a:
Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O

CO2 in air reacts with Calcium Hydroxide to form Calcium Carbonate (CaCO3).

CaCO3 is a hard white solid → wall becomes hard and shiny over time ✅

This is a Combination Reaction.
Note: Fresh whitewash looks dull but hardens within 2-3 days.

lba_mcq.q: Rahul took out a silver ornament stored for years and found it had turned black. Which chemical phenomenon is responsible for this?
lba_mcq.explanation: Silver reacts with H2S in air to form Ag2S (black). This is Corrosion — a slow Oxidation Reaction that changes the surface of metals.

lba_mcq.q: After boiling an egg, can it be converted back to a raw egg by cooling it?
options: Yes, by cooling it in cold water
No, because it is an irreversible chemical change
No, because it is only a physical change
lba_mcq.explanation: Boiling an egg denatures the proteins permanently — a new substance forms. This is an irreversible chemical change. Physical changes can be reversed, but chemical changes generally cannot.

lba_mcq.q: When a candle burns, two changes occur — wax melting AND wax burning. Which type of change is each?
options: Melting = physical change, Burning = chemical change
Melting = chemical change, Burning = physical change
lba_mcq.explanation: Wax melting = Physical change (reversible — wax solidifies again on cooling). Wax burning = Chemical change (CO2 and H2O are formed, irreversible).

lba_mcq.q: After taking an antacid tablet, the burning sensation in the stomach reduces. Which type of chemical reaction is occurring?
lba_mcq.explanation: Antacid (Base) + HCl in stomach (Acid) → Salt + Water. This is a Neutralisation reaction — a type of Double Displacement Reaction where ions are exchanged.

lba_mcq.q: White silver chloride turns grey when kept in sunlight. Which reaction causes this colour change?
lba_mcq.explanation: 2AgCl → 2Ag + Cl2 (in presence of light). Silver (grey) is released. This is Photodecomposition. This principle is used in Black & White Photography.

lba_mcq.q: A hand warmer packet becomes hot immediately after opening. What chemical reaction is responsible?
lba_mcq.explanation: Iron powder + O2 → Iron Oxide + Heat. This is a slow Exothermic Oxidation reaction. The heat released warms the hand. Same principle as rusting but controlled and faster.

lba_mcq.q: Zinc and Iron react with copper sulphate solution, but gold does not react. What is the correct reason?
options: Gold is expensive so it does not react
Zn and Fe are more reactive than Cu; Gold is less reactive than Cu
Copper is more reactive than gold
lba_mcq.explanation: Reactivity Series: Zn > Fe > Cu > Au. Only a more reactive metal can displace a less reactive metal from its salt solution. Gold is below copper in the reactivity series, so no displacement occurs.

lba_mcq.q: When lead nitrate Pb(NO3)2 is heated, brown coloured fumes are produced. What gas causes this colour?
lba_mcq.explanation: 2Pb(NO3)2 → 2PbO + 4NO2 + O2 (on heating). Brown fumes are NO2 — Nitrogen dioxide. This is a Thermal Decomposition Reaction. Yellow PbO and O2 are also released.
